plugins.name: gsd-status-mod
plugins.description: A Claude Code mod for GSD projects: a live pane (roadmap, agent tree with forks, cost and context, work streams, session log, pace and fit forecast, timeline, trends, a markdown reader) plus a status band, a next-action hint and /gsd-status, read from .planning/.
